newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds banking reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds banking reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements (RPs), as many economists had expected.
The Fed faced a small add need Wednesday, and some analysts had thought the outstanding 14-day fixed system RP would suffice.
Just before the Fed intervened, fed funds were trading at 5.5 percent, right at the Fed's current official target level.
